ClosingsDay.description:
Every school with a weather status on one local day, as parallel columns.

Row i is gaps[i], statuses[i], announced[i] and reasons[i]; rows are in school
order. shifts and clocks hold one entry for each delayed or early-dismissal
row, in row order: the k-th entry belongs to the k-th such row. manual lists the
rows the site's own team set by hand, by position, and details the plain details
of the rows that have some, by position.

announced.description: When each row's status was first posted, in minutes before generated_at; null when the listing gave no time.

clocks.description: For each delayed or early-dismissal row, the stated opening or dismissal time; null unless the listing states it.

details.description: The plain details the listings state beside each row's status, for the rows that have some: [row position, [details]], rows ascending, details ascending; empty when no row has any.

gaps.description: Each row's school, as a gap from the previous row's.

manual.description: The rows the site's own team set by hand, as positions in this day's rows (0 is the first), ascending; empty when there are none.

reasons.description: The weather each row names; null when none was named.

shifts.description: For each delayed or early-dismissal row, how late the day starts or how early it ends; null unless the listing states it.

ClosingsDay.title: ClosingsDay

Detail.description:
A plain detail a listing states beside its status (:mod:`snowlight.live.details`).

The site says each in its own words (``src/copy-details.ts``), never the listing's.
In the order the panel says them: who (0-2), buses (3-7), meals (8-11), pre-K
(12-14), after school (15-19) and offices (20-21).
Detail.title: Detail

DetailRow.description: A row's position in its day and the details it states, ascending.

DirectoryStamp.description:
The directory a file's school and district indexes point into.

It must equal generated_on, count and the number of districts of the
schools/meta.json the reader has loaded; otherwise the file is ignored.
DirectoryStamp.title: DirectoryStamp

LocalDate.description: A calendar day in the school's own time zone: YYYY-MM-DD.

MinuteOfDay.description: A local wall-clock time as minutes after midnight (630 is 10:30).

MinutesAgo.description: Whole minutes before the minute of generated_at: the moment is the start of the UTC minute that many minutes earlier, and 0 is generated_at's own minute.

ReasonCode.description: The cause a status was posted for, as a Reason code: 0 winter storm, 1 ice, 2 extreme cold, 3 flooding, 4 hurricane, 5 severe storms, 6 heat, 7 power outage. A reader takes any other code up to 255 as a stated cause it has no name for: it shows no words for it and never fails to read the file.

SchemaVersion.description: The file format's version. A reader refuses a file with any other.

SchoolGap.description: A school index written as its distance from the one before it: index = previous index + 1 + gap, and the first previous index is -1. So [4, 0, 2] is schools 4, 5 and 8.

ShiftMinutes.description: A length of time in whole minutes.

Status.description:
What a school is doing on a day because of weather.

0 closed, 1 delayed start, 2 remote or e-learning, 3 early dismissal.
Status.title: Status

UtcInstant.description: A moment in UTC, whole seconds: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

description:
live/closings.json: every school closed, delayed, remote or dismissing early for weather.

One group per local day, in date order; each school has a row on at most two
of them, its local today and tomorrow. A school with no row has no weather
status on file; whether it is open is known only where live/covered.json says so.

days.description: The local days with a status, sorted. Each is today or tomorrow somewhere in the contiguous US at generated_at: two dates, or three between 04:00 and 08:00 UTC.
